subject: Forecast stage criteria update — seller quickstart & small-group clinics
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Forecast stage criteria update — seller quickstart & small-group clinics

Team,

Quick note to share the finalized changes to our Forecast stage definitions (Commit / Best Case / Pipeline). We agreed these updates after the review with Finance last week — the goal is to reduce variance on large ACV deals and make seller behavior consistent across regions.

Attached: stage-definitions-v2.pdf (redlines + examples) and a cleaned export of open deals for review (open-deals-export-20270420.xlsx).

High level changes you need to internalize this week:
- Commit: must have signed SOW/PO or legal-signed term sheet OR an explicit procurement timeline with confirmed internal approver and date.
- Best Case: realistic customer approval path + procurement trigger; vendor evaluations complete; exec champion identified but no signed docs.
- Pipeline: early discovery; opportunity qualifies but key risks remain (no procurement path yet).

Immediate asks:
1) Sellers: Please update stage for any deals >$50k in your pipeline by COB Friday. Use the spreadsheet to make row-level notes about risk (procurement, budget, timeline).
2) Managers: I’ll run two 30-minute quickstart clinics on Wednesday and Thursday — one focused on large ACV rules, the other on tag hygiene for forecasting. Signups here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Xy_example_drive_link
3) CS (Marissa): Can you prepare 2–3 case examples where stage reclassification changed forecast outcome in prior quarters? We’ll use these in the clinic.

I’ll follow up with a calendar invite and the seller quickstart deck.

Thanks,
Vanessa
Head of Revenue Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachments: stage-definitions-v2.pdf (PDF, 14 pages); open-deals-export-20270420.xlsx (Excel, 1 sheet)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Forecast stage criteria update — seller quickstart & small-group clinics

Thanks Vanessa — this looks good. Two quick items:

- Can we add a short checklist to the Commit definition for procurement artifacts (PO/SOW/contract signed or "Procurement POC + expected approval date")? Sellers often mark Commit without a PO.
- For Best Case, can we include a required field for the "probability driver" (e.g., exec signoff pending, procurement evaluation complete, proof-of-concept success)? That’ll help Finance map signals to probabilities.

I can join the Thursday clinic. Also, flagging that BlueHouse Analytics (BH-4892) is scheduled for final pricing review on Friday; I want our sellers to apply the new definitions before EOD so our Q2 forecast reflects the change.

-karthik
VP Sales Operations
